answer: At dawn, trust propagates through an attestation graph by bounded-length random walks, limiting how far influence travels without well-connected endorsements. A sybil cluster can be large internally, like chambers in karst, yet a sparse external cut gives it low conductance. Under a rule weighting votes by trusted walk-reached attestations, conductance and min-cut bounds limit its aggregate voting weight to support crossing that boundary, not self-issued claims; a relic credential adds no independent path.
